"''He says you spilled his drink.|The Alpha Trawler and the bartender, to Din Djarin|audio=Bartender-Spilled.flac||noquote=1}} The '''Alpha Trawler''' was a [[human]] who, along with a [[Beta Trawler|human]] companion and a [[Quarren Trawler|Quarren]] companion, threatened a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|Mythrol]] in a [[Boatman's Reach|public house]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Pagodon]] around [[9 ABY]]. In [[Huttese]], he threatened to sell the [[Mythrol]]'s glands at the port, and commented that the Mythrol's musk must be sweet because of his youth. During this incident, a [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] named [[Din Djarin]] arrived to collect a [[bounty]] on the Mythrol. The human, along with his two companions, threatened Djarin, claiming that he had made the alpha trawler spill his drink. A fight ensued, during which Djarin incapacitated all three of them. ==Biography== ===Harassing a Mythrol=== {{Quote|Look at his glands! I bet we could sell them at the port.|translated=1|The lead trawler points out the Mythrol's gills to the Quarren|}} [[File:Trawler_Trio.png|thumb|left|250px|The human harassed a Mythrol with two other trawlers.]] The [[human]] [[Gender|male]] worked as a trawler on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Pagodon]] in [[9 ABY]].{{MandoDate|1}} Within a [[Boatman's Reach|public house]] at the settlement [[Ferryman's Reach]], he harassed a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|young Mythrol]] alongside a [[Quarren Trawler|Quarren]] and [[Beta Trawler|human]]. Speaking in [[Huttese]],{{InsiderCite|223|Embodying Vizsla}} the trawler pointed out that they could sell the [[Mythrol]]'s glands a a nearby [[port]], and that the musk he produced would be sweet. Despite the Mythrol surrendering his [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] on the table, the human prepared to him with a [[knife]] while the [[Quarren]] pulled him to his feet. Before they could cut the Mythrol, they were interrupted by the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]]'s sudden entrance. Noticing the spilled drink on the table, he claimed the Mandalorian had spilled it while approaching him at the counter, signaling his companions. ===Taking on a Mandalorian=== {{Quote|Is that real Beskar Steel?|The trawler, in Huttese, to Djarin|translated=1|audio=Trawler-Beskar.flac|}} [[File:Alpha_Trawler_The_Mandalorian.png|thumb|250px|The human was bested by Din Djarin.]] Continuing to threaten Djarin, the [[Unidentified bartender (Pagodon)|bartender]] translated his threats in [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]]. The human then asked if the [[armor]] he was made of real [[beskar]], as the other trawlers surrounded him. As the bartender slid another drink to the human, Djarin grabbed the cup and knocked them back, then slammed it into the other human trawler, knocking him out. He proceeded to slam the Quarren's face into the counter, before the human trawler attempted to stab him with his knife. Djarin then grabbed his arm and redirected the blade into his back, incapacitating him. Djarin then caught the fleeing Quarren with his [[whipcord launcher]] and shot the entrance's controls, which promptly activated the door and sliced the trawler in half. ==Personality and traits== The human had light skin with a scar on the right side of his face, as well as a bald head and a [[Color|dark brown]] beard, and spoke Huttese. He ignored the Mythrol's offer of credits, as he found the Mythrol's glands to be far more profitable. Upon seeing Djarin, he used the spilled drink on the table as leverage to threaten him. ==Skills and abilities== When fighting Djarin, the human attempted to stab him with his knife, but was incapacitated when Djarin redirected the blade to his back instead. ==Equipment== The human carried a knife and wore a brown coat, brown pants and black [[glove]]s. ==Behind the scenes== The Alpha Trawler appeared in the [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|first episode]] of the [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[November 12]], 2019.{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|date=2019-09-24|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf#page=1]|archivedate=20210623202717}} Identified in the credits as "Alpha Trawler," he was portrayed by [[Tait Fletcher]], who also played [[Paz Vizsla]] in costume in [[Chapter 3: The Sin]],{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}} which aired on [[November 22]], 2019. According to Fletcher, he did not know about his role as the trawler after he auditioned for it, but later received a call informing him that he received the role.{{WebCite|url=https://www.bobafettfanclub.com/news/film-tv/exclusive-interview-with-tait-fletcher-heavy-infantry-mandalorian-and-alpha-trawler-in-the-mandalorian|text=Exclusive Interview with Tait Fletcher, Heavy Infantry Mandalorian and Alpha Trawler in "The Mandalorian"|author=Aaron Proctor|date=2020-02-10|archivedate=20200210084331}} ==Appearances== *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}} {{1st}} *''[[The Mandalorian: Season 1: Volume 1]]'' *[[The Mandalorian 1|''The Mandalorian'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|aOC8E8z_ifw|The Mandalorian | Official Trailer | Disney+ | Streaming Nov. 12|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-official-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|2RVnrBLOBcI|The Mandalorian | Special Look | Disney+}} *{{DisneyGallery|Score}} *{{DisneyGallery|Connections}} *{{SW|url=series/the-mandalorian/chapter-1-guide|text="The Mandalorian" Episode Guide | The Mandalorian}} *[[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season One)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One]] {{Po}} *{{InsiderCite|223|Embodying Vizsla}} *{{GermanFanCite|120|Tait Fletcher: Von MMA nach Mandalore}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{WebCite|url=https://www.bobafettfanclub.com/news/film-tv/exclusive-interview-with-tait-fletcher-heavy-infantry-mandalorian-and-alpha-trawler-in-the-mandalorian|text=Exclusive Interview with Tait Fletcher, Heavy Infantry Mandalorian and Alpha Trawler in "The Mandalorian"|archivedate=20200210084331}} {{Interlang |es=Arrastrero alfa no identificado |fr=Chalutier humain non-identifié 1 |ja=名称不明の人間のトローラー（アルファ） |ka=ალფა ტროლერი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
